{{Top|leg}}
'''Cavern's Delight''' was a ride that was located in [[Aucellis Park]], an entertainment park that operated on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Keriba VI]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The park was secretly an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] re-education facility that manipulated the minds of visitors, and Cavern's Delight served as the entrance to an underground re-education center. The ride itself was a thrill ride, where riders were propelled through a series of caverns on [[Landspeeder/Legends|hovercars]].
